text: はかせから　レッドくんへの　おくりものを　もって　でかけた　はずなんだけど…　２ばんどうろ　あたりで　レッドくんを　さがす　って　いってたから　そのへんかな？

structure.jp: はかせから　レッドくんへの　おくりものを　もって
structure.en: carrying a gift from the Professor for Red

structure.jp: でかけた　はずなんだけど…
structure.en: he should have gone out, but...

structure.jp: ２ばんどうろ　あたりで　レッドくんを　さがす　って　いってたから
structure.en: he said he'd look for Red around Route 2, so

patterns.name: 〜はず
patterns.explanation: はず after a verb says the speaker is fairly sure it is so, based on what he knows. でかけた　はず = 'he should have gone out'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: さがす　って　いってた
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which comes after the words someone said. さがす　って　いってた = 'he was saying he would look'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because' or 'so', giving the reason for what comes next. いってたから　そのへんかな = 'he said so, so maybe he's around there'.
